string-array.item: Use the week control above the timetable. Return to the current week from that panel. Try switching the example below.
Tap a course for its time, room and teacher, then choose Edit. Try opening the example card.
Completed classes and enabled holiday dimming share one dim state. Causes never compound; weekends alone do not dim classes. Dimming does not delete a course or cancel reminders.
Open timetable management → Import. Use a supported school portal, file or text.
Check the semester start, weeks and class times before confirming. Use your actual number of periods; twelve is not required.
Use the timetable More menu → Refresh current timetable to fetch courses while keeping class times. Review how local edits are handled before confirming.
Tap a course and choose Edit, or open the course list in timetable management. Safely try editing the example name below.
Review the name, room, weeks and periods before saving. When leaving unsaved edits, follow the prompt to keep or discard them.
Edit a course for permanent changes. Use holiday adjustments in Settings for temporary moves; do not change the whole semester to move one class.
Fill distinguishes classes with soft surfaces; color bars keep the grid simple. Try both below, then choose in Appearance.
Timetable and weekly widget title positions are independent. Centered titles use only the space above room and teacher details.
Appearance supports a timetable background with visibility, softness, saturation and position controls. Keep course text readable first.
Today · small is for a quick glance; Today shows more; Two days helps you prepare; This week gives an overview. Try the content previews below.
Open My → Widgets. If your launcher cannot add directly, touch and hold an empty home screen area and select Classy in the widget list.
Choose the timetable and display options in widget settings. Timetable names and title alignment belong there; actual size depends on the launcher grid.
Before-class reminders help you leave on time; daily summaries help plan your day. This example does not send notifications.
Open My → Reminders, enable the master switch, then choose reminders. Also allow system notification, sound and banner permissions. The master switch is off by default.
If reminders stop in the background, follow the device guidance on the reminder page. Progress cards appear in notifications; this does not mean every phone supports a top-of-screen island.
Open More → Semester overview on the timetable. Week markers reveal alternating weeks and courses held in only part of the semester.
Open a course calendar, then select a date for times, room and teacher. The example below uses fixed sample weeks, not your courses.
For moved classes, follow the actual date and adjustment notes in details rather than relying only on the usual weekday.
Period numbers need actual start and end times for reminders and completion status. Compare two example routines below.
Manage class routines in timetable management and select the right one for your timetable. Check morning, afternoon and evening times.
Refreshing a timetable keeps its existing routine. If the school changes class times, update the routine separately.
